# AIMarket MCP server

by alexar76 · official

Lets your AI fetch web pages, run web searches, verify answers, and look up paid capabilities on the AIMarket hub.

This is a small helper program that gives your AI a few extra skills: reading web pages, searching the web, double-checking answers, and browsing a marketplace of paid tools. It is made by the same team behind the Metis and ARGUS tools, and it is aimed at people who want their AI to reach outside the chat safely. You do not need to be technical to use it once someone sets it up for you.

What is an MCP server? The 30-second version

On its own, your AI can only chat with you using what it already learned. An MCP server is a small helper program you connect to your AI, and it gives the AI a new skill or a connection to an outside service. This one connects your AI to the web and to the AIMarket hub, so it can look up pages, run searches, check answers, and find paid tools when you ask. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
